title: Authorization documents
description: Consent and authorization templates. The clinic logo from General settings is inserted centered at a fixed size.
empty_hint: Create one here. Then, from the patient history, the consultation menu lets you send it to the owner.
cuerpo_hint: motivo is that consultation’s reason. Centered logo. {{ciudad}} is the district from General settings. Typical date: ciudad, dia, mes_nombre and anio.
ia_hint: Upload a PDF or photo of the consent form and AI will draft the template. Then you review and save.
ia_wait: This usually takes a few seconds. Don’t close this window.
ia_error: Couldn’t generate the template. Try another photo or PDF.
delete_description: «{{nombre}}» will be deleted. Already signed documents are kept.
